ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: line 222 had DrinkPerks + StationPredictWinTab imports concatenated into a single line WITHOUT a newline — the `// Win Wallet — bar-wheel perks` comment swallowed the entire `import StationPredictWinTab from '@/StationPredictWinTab'` statement. Result: ReferenceError 'StationPredictWinTab is not defined' at AppRouter render → the ENTIRE web app crashed to the 'Something went wrong' error boundary on every page. Fixed in this iteration by splitting into two lines. Reference: /app/frontend/src/App.js:222

action_items: PLEASE VERIFY the App.js fix stays in place — the previous edit at line 222 collapsed two imports onto one line and broke the entire web frontend. Consider adding an ESLint rule (import/newline-after-import) or a CI smoke test that loads / and asserts a known selector to catch this class of bug next time.

Optional: BarGameCard.jsx uses a local `segments` fallback inside spin() (line 102: `(res.segments || segments).length`) — segments is defined AFTER spin() in the same function scope. In practice res.segments is always returned by the backend so this branch never trips, but it's a TDZ/hoisting foot-gun; recommend moving segments derivation above spin() or using `res.segments?.length ?? data.config?.segments?.length ?? 1`.
critical_code_review_comments: The App.js typo (single-line import concat) shipped through because ESLint was disabled at build (DISABLE_ESLINT_PLUGIN=true in /app/frontend/.env). Consider enabling ESLint for import syntax rules only — this bug is exactly the sort ESLint import/newline-after-import catches instantly.
routes/bar_games.py still has two __all__ declarations (harmless — flagged in iter185).

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (web crash): /app/frontend/src/App.js line 222 read `import DrinkPerks from "@/pages/bar/DrinkPerks";  // Win Wallet — bar-wheel perksimport StationPredictWinTab from "@/StationPredictWinTab";  // Sub-Phase E3 — business builder` — the trailing `//` comment on the first import swallowed the second import statement as part of the comment (JS single-line comments run to end of line). Runtime: `StationPredictWinTab` was never imported, so when `<ProtectedRoute><StationPredictWinTab /></ProtectedRoute>` at line 1080 evaluated during AppRouter render, React threw ReferenceError which propagated up to the app-level error boundary. FIX: Split the two imports back onto separate lines. VERIFICATION: after fix, all ENH2/3/4 flows + spin regression validated end-to-end on web + mobile.
